jam: Clear paper jam (fuser area for code 13.20); if toner is low, swap toner; restart the print spooler (cups); re-add the queue; power-cycle if it persists.
toner: Swap the toner/ink cartridge; clear any jam; restart the spooler; re-add the queue.
offline: Ping the device; if unreachable, reboot via its management API (printer IPP/SNMP, signage CMS, controller API) or PoE port-cycle; check recent changes; power-cycle as last resort.
black: Re-seat HDMI; reboot the player; re-push the content/schedule from the CMS; swap the player if it persists.
hang: Restart the room app (Zoom/Teams Rooms) via API/management; reboot codec and controller; reseat USB devices; dispatch AV tech if it persists.
hung: Restart the room app (Zoom/Teams Rooms) via API/management; reboot codec and controller; reseat USB devices; dispatch AV tech if it persists.
dropping: Controller-API reboot the AP; PoE port power-cycle; RF tune (channel/power); add an AP if coverage is the gap.
can't join: Restart the room app (Zoom/Teams Rooms); reboot codec/controller; reseat USB mic/cam; dispatch AV tech if it persists.
